text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent two-stage acceleration. A 
run truly fitting for Twin Turbo. The 
Trainer rejoices, confident she can handle 
mixed Senior-class medium-distance races. 
And if luck allows, maybe even the Kikuka 
Sho...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However... right then, breaking news 
arrived announcing that Tokai Teio had 
abandoned her bid for the Kikuka Sho.
